title.tr: Taş duvar boyunca inen ahşap merdiven
title.en: Timber steps running down beside a stone wall

alt.tr: Çimenliğe inen çapraz korkuluklu ahşap merdiven, solda taş duvar ve tel çit
alt.en: Cross-braced timber steps leading down to the lawn, with a stone wall and mesh fence on the left

caption.tr: Evin önündeki seviyeden bahçeye inen ahşap merdiven. Basamaklar taş duvara paralel uzanıyor.
caption.en: A timber staircase leading down from the level by the house to the garden, running parallel to the stone wall.
